name: IndustrialCore
description: Reusable, hardware-agnostic building blocks for industrial ESP32 controllers: a millis()-based cooperative scheduler, a latching alarm manager, a structured serial console (banner / status table / log levels), and a Modbus RTU register-bank slave for SCADA telemetry. No delay(), no board-specific code.
keywords: industrial, modbus, scada, alarms, telemetry, esp32, scheduler
